UGREEN AX1800 WiFi 6 Adapter USB 3.0 | CM499/ 65225
The UGREEN AX1800 WiFi 6 adapter provides high-speed wireless network connectivity for PCs, laptops, and desktop computers, supporting Windows 11/10.

Advanced Wi-Fi 6 Technology: Equipped with OFDMA and 1024QAM technology, the UGREEN Wi-Fi 6 adapter offers faster transmission speeds, wider coverage, and stronger stability compared to Wi-Fi 5. Enjoy lower and more stable latency while gaming, similar to a wired connection.

AX1800 Super Speed: The UGREEN AX1800 USB Wi-Fi adapter supports both 5GHz (up to 1201Mbps) and 2.4GHz bands (up to 576Mbps), allowing for instant large data downloads and smooth movie streaming without lag.

Wider Wi-Fi Coverage: Featuring Beamforming and MIMO technology, the UGREEN USB Wi-Fi dongle provides wider coverage and stability for better performance, ensuring smooth and fast network connectivity throughout your home.
Built-in Driver: The UGREEN USB wireless network adapter comes with built-in drivers for Windows 11/10, allowing for easy plug-and-play use without the need for complicated driver downloads.

WPA3 Advanced Security: The latest WPA3 security protocol offers stronger privacy protection capabilities, safeguarding your personal network information. When entering personal information or passwords, WPA3 helps prevent data leakage as much as possible.
